reason: The primary CIF parses and symmetry-expands as a primitive P-62m (No. 189) cell with a=b=6.201292 A, c=3.779866 A, nine fully occupied atoms (Yb3Cd3C3, Z=3), and the stated ordering Yb 3g, Cd 3f, C 2c+1b. All 26 significant observed reflections are indexed (none unmatched within the observed line set), and the trace instantiates and coordinate-refines this atomic model over the full 5-90 degree profile: Rwp=0.04167, independently reproduced, is essentially at an independently checked Pawley-style profile floor of Rwp=0.04022. Integrated-intensity/global-search and whole-profile refinements converge on x(Yb)=0.57797 and x(Cd)=0.25600. All six symmetry-preserving element permutations were tested; exhaustive checking of all 1,680 fixed-site Yb/Cd/C assignments likewise leaves the submitted ordering uniquely best (the nearest symmetry-lowered ordering gives Rwp about 0.07145, and the full Yb/Cd swap is much worse). The primitive-standardized cell is unchanged, so the half-volume orthorhombic indexing description is not a distinct submitted-framework branch. Periodic shells show no overlaps (shortest Cd-C 2.344 A, Yb-C 2.617 A, Yb-Cd 2.749 A), complete coordination is plausible, and bond-valence analysis supports charge-balanced Yb2+/Cd2+/C4-. No concrete diffraction-compatible ordering, symmetry, occupancy, superstructure, or framework ambiguity survives strongly enough to justify another attempt.
